sources.entry: AzuraCast - Modern and accessible web radio management suite. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: AzuraCast is a self-hosted, Docker-distributed web radio management suite that bundles an Internet radio software stack with a web interface and API for running stations.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes AzuraCast as an Internet radio station "in a box": a self-contained, self-hostable suite of free and open-source web radio software distributed using Docker. It provides a web interface for managing stations and a documented API. The README links to documentation pages on the included software, system requirements, and installation, but does not detail specific streaming features in the text itself. A live demo is available at demo.azuracast.com. Bug reports go through GitHub Issues, and feature requests go through FeatureUpvote.
use_cases: manage web radio streams from a browser
host a community or online radio channel
manage radio stations through an API
how_to_run: Follow the installation guide in the AzuraCast documentation to install on your own server
notable: Distributed as a Docker-based, self-contained suite with the radio software stack included
Web interface and documented API for managing stations
Live demo site available for trying it before installing
Developed with a stated policy of human-reviewed code and no AI-generated contributions
caveats: Requires basic Linux shell familiarity to install
Free software maintained by volunteers, so responses may be delayed
Installation requires running it on your own server
